title: After a restart, Telegram forwarding fails with "session not found" for its target session
outcome: Telegram forwarding after a host restart either reaches its configured target session or reports clearly and recoverably that the target no longer exists, naming it. It does not fail with a bare "session not found" during startup while sessions are still loading.
acceptance: A behavioural test: Telegram forwarding attempted before the target session is loaded at startup is deferred or retried once the session exists, instead of failing with 'session not found'
A behavioural test: forwarding to a target session that really no longer exists reports which target is missing and how to reconfigure it, once, without a crash or loop
Existing Telegram forwarding tests stay green

The 2026-11-14 06:11:35Z occurrence is recorded on w-0419 (note 2f1eee57) by Termal::Fable2, who filed this item minutes earlier before finding that coverage.
